exclusion_rule: NOT_USEFUL_FOR_DIAGNOSTIC_INSTALL means exclude from automatic shortlist/install without explicit new evidence; do not delete archival photo.
taxonomic_guardrail: Species names are source metadata only; this visual review describes visible anatomy, not independent verification of taxon concept or comparison to identified specimen.
next_steps: Visually inspect promising originals at full pixel resolution, especially milkweed corona, grass spikelets, oak acorn/cups, Euphorbia cyathia and seed details.
Crosscheck currently installed photo IDs, source-page rights and work-claims immediately before each canonical addition.
Keep the existing rights holds and do not replace image licenses or crop out required attribution.
Install at most one or two complementary views per species once both exact identity and visible role are confirmed, then confirm local JPG bytes, metadata and web rendering.
